journal: OSTI final report, Westinghouse Research Laboratories to Office of Saline Water, Contract 14-01-0001-2126 (Chia-Tsun Liu and W. T. Lindsay Jr.)
needs_pass2_reason: Scanned report with OCR text layer; Table 1 needed two corrections after image check (75 misread as 15; 0.28237 truncated), Table 2 text layer was noisy from hand-written annotations (values rewritten from image). Any correction counts as pass 2.
experimental_method: Differential vapor-pressure-lowering cells (solution vs pure water) with pressure balancing at 75-300 C; boiling point elevations derived by the authors from the vapor pressure lowering using steam tables.
uncertainties_stated: Solution vapor pressure readings reproducible within +-0.02% of total pressure; differential vapor pressure within +-0.04% (section 5.1.2). Accuracy lowest where delta p is small (low concentration, low T).
quality_remarks: Table 7 row 115.396 / 6.9350 / 9.726: Tb + BPE = 125.122, not the 125 C isotherm of its block (others add to isotherm within 0.001): likely misprint, kept. Table 8 200 C row uses literature solubility (Robson) for the molality. Scan has hand-written annotations next to Table 2 (ignored). Temperature scale not stated. Pure-water p0 values are steam-table values, not measured. BPE tables 7 and 13 are reductions of the VPL data of Tables 2 and 12, not independent measurements.

not_extracted_tables.Table 6: derived thermal quantities (heat of solution, entropy, heat capacity)
not_extracted_tables.Table 10: composition definition of simulated sea water (not data)
not_extracted_tables.Table 11: composition of the SSW used (used as composition in mappings 12 and 13, not a measured-property table)
not_extracted_tables.Table 15: comparison of observed and calculated BPE (fit residuals)
not_extracted_tables.Table 17: comparison of estimates with measurements at 100 C (model comparison)
not_extracted_tables.Table 18: comparison of 1970 and 1966 BPE with literature estimates
not_extracted_tables.Tables A1-A20 (appendix): derived thermodynamic functions of NaCl solutions (smoothed/calculated)

changes_after_image_check: Table 2: all values re-read from image (text layer contained handwriting noise; printed values otherwise unchanged)
extraction_notes: Side-by-side blocks in Tables 2 and 7 stacked left then right. Temperature/p0 printed once per block were filled down in Tables 8, 9, 12, 13 (blank in print). Table 8 (MgSO4) extracted because Mg and SO4 belong to the six-ion set although MgSO4 is not in the brief's salt list. Tables 12-13 composition: multiple of Table 11 composition (see mapping). Measured primary data: Table 1 (vapor pressure of saturated NaCl solution) and delta p columns of Tables 8, 9, 12. Osmotic coefficients and BPE are authors' reductions. Page offset between printed and PDF pages is 13 up to Table 2 and 12 afterwards. Not run: second sanity of Table 9/12 phi against delta p.
sanity_checks: Table 1: p0 - dp = p for all rows within 0.02 mm Hg; atm = mm Hg/760 within 2e-4. Table 13: Tsol - Tb = BPE within 0.002 for all rows. Table 7: Tb + BPE = isotherm except the noted row.
pass2_diff: Tables 1, 2, 7, 8, 9, 12, 13: 217 rows; every pass-2 number occurs in pass 1; differences are the temperature and p0 keys filled down in pass 1.
